TEXT: The day after the Siscaly tournament.
I took the chance for a stroll during the sunset to take a break from studying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, hello?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, are you free right now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...So? What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I want to tell you that I'll be going early tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? Is there something tomorrow?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Why... There's the school trip tomorrow!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: AH!
Crap... I totally forgot about it!
There was the Siscaly tournament, so I forgot how soon it was...
I-I'm such an idiot!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, are you all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You're not going to tell me you "haven't prepared anything", right?
That's exactly what it is... Everything about this school trip had completely disappeared from my mind, including the preparation.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-How should I say this...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What's wrong? Your voice's kinda shaky.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh... how should I put it, I'm in trouble.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I already felt like it wasn't right when I saw that you left your school trip handbook at school...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ehh! Seriously?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: From what it sounds like, Kyou-chan, you didn't check the contents?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I didn't! Was there something of importance?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: There's a sticker in it that's used for the group activity for that very day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This is bad--! Should I sneak into the school right now?!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I-It's not necessary for you to do that. I took Kyou-chan's handbook with me as a precaution.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: As expected from Manami! That's my childhood friend! I'm coming over to your place right now!!

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: Oh, isn't that Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That voice... could it be...
I turned around, and there stood--

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ayase...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Good day, Onii-san. What are you in such a hurry for?
Aragaki Ayase. Kirino's close friend, as well as her modeling colleague.
In other words, her "official" friend.
Besides my sister, Ayase is the prettiest person I've met so far.
Honestly, as far as appearances goes, she's totally my type but...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Could it be... that you're plotting lewd things against Kirino again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that the only explanation you could come up to explain my sprint...
And what's with that "again"? There hasn't been a single time where I've planned anything lewd against her since she was born!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Looking at the breathless perverted Onii-san running like that, anyone would agree.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ugh...!
That's right. Because of various reasons, Ayase firmly believes I'm a pervert.
Because of many complicated reasons that entwine together, resolving that misunderstanding is impossible.
So to me, Ayase is a problematic person in many ways.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Fate sure is ironic...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hmm? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, nothing.
So please don't press your personal alarm button just yet.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: That aside, weren't you in a hurry?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, now that you mention it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: However, it's rare for you to start a conversation with me, so I might as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I merely saw Onii-san and greeted you.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: There wasn't a particular reason, so I'll take my leave now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: And there she goes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Good grief, my heart is moved every time she makes that angelic face. She truly is a devil...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wait, I shouldn't be thinking of these things right now. I need to hurry to Manami's place!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yo, Ayase! Sorry, I'm in a hurry right now!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah. Could it be that you heard something regarding the school trip from Onee-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? Why would Ayase know about this?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I've heard about the school trip while talking on the phone with Onee-san yesterday.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san isn't serious enough, so Onee-san was worried.
Guh... That Manami, you didn't say anything weird to Ayase right?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ahh, I only heard about the school trip from Onee-san and nothing else, so don't worry.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Besides, my evaluation of Onii-san is already rock bottom, so it won't go any lower.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ahaha...
...Even though I brought it upon myself, I can't get over it...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Now, now, don't just stand there and sulk. How about hurrying up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onee-san is waiting for you, isn't she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-That's right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: See you, Ayase!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes, see you next time.
